notes.title: Kitten Burst v3.01 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Kitten Burst! The launch has gone amazing so far. 

If you like the game, please consider leaving a positive review! It helps with Steam algorithm stuff. We're already at a "Very Positive" rating which is huge! Thank You!

[b]Here's some quick patch notes for v3.01:[/b]

-Fixed a sequence break in an ending scene.

-Paperclip hat was causing the boss cameras to not work.

-Webtoy ach fixed!

-DoABarrelRoll ach fixed! (finally)

-In the intro section if you stay in slowmotion through an entire section while holding down the accelerate button, the slowmotion carrys through to the cutscenes. Now I kick players out of slowmo after a set time to prevent this.

-Fixed bug where if you get to the Gacha Shop before the intro music finishes, both songs would play

-Lowered the sky in Platform so you can't escape

notes.title: Part C: Development Update
notes.content:
Part C Development Update
---

Hey! It's been a while since Part B: launched in April so I wanted to give an update. I've been hard at work at finishing the last part of Kitten Burst and I'm gearing up for the full release of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/75679b165c166405ead125322b9ebffa0bbd3024.png[/img]

Originally when I launched Part A: in Early Access in September 2022, I estimated Part B and C to both take 6 months of development time. Part B actually took 8 months to develop. I'm currently halfway into development of Part C, which is looking like it will take 10 months.

My new expected release date of Kitten Burst is Jan 2024. I know delays are disappointing, but the game will be better if I take the time to finish it properly. I want to make sure I have plenty of time to Playtest, QA, and Balance the game before release.

Here's what I've been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/4b44c0896f98f346a57426b3f3675ddd7364ef19.png[/img]

I've completely redesigned the opening race/cinematic of the game with a new environment, more cats to fly against, and a more intense race path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/a85fda49fa59d5a753c23c8909dc532bc7f70b41.png[/img]

I've also finished work on the largest level in the game. It's an MMORPG server called "The Lost Loch". Here you'll uncover the origins of the hacker group SHIVER!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/f3042438f0f6fc667fa932b83b435aa27a750ce8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/037886037032faa2207ae5ba09ac957edc99ea11.jpg[/img]

This level has 2 new bossfights which I'll keep secret for now.

Here's what's left to work on (keeping it vague so no spoilers):

-A cinematic 
-The final level of the game
-The final boss of the game
-The ending sequence

I've already started pre-production on all of these. You can join the Discord or follow me on Twitter for updates! I also want to make more YouTube Devlog videos in the next couple of months!

That's all for now. Thank you for all of your support! 

TTYL

notes.title: Kitten Burst v1.03 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Kitten Burst v1.03 - Patch Notes[/b]
----------------------------
Added rocks to nullspace to help with sand readability
Slightly higher LOD range on nullspace landscape to prevent visual clipping into the ground in some places.
Added blush to the rainbow pastry "hat" (it does something else too btw!)

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Your boost no longer gets reset when you crash
- Hitbox for checkpoints increased to be way more generous
- Reworked the circuit "Bigfan"
- Rebalanced Ion rewards for circuits. Buffed "Throughput" & "Bigfan". Nerfed "Dunesurfer"

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-Softlock: If you complete a race and then save and exit the game, without exiting the race first you get softlocked
 -You can now no longer save, or save and quit in races, you have to exit the race first
 -Races now only save on exit

-Softlock: exiting the game during certain dialogue/cutscene sequence can softlock the game
 -You can now no longer save, or save and quit during dialogue or cutscenes.
 
-Sequence Break: Exiting nullspace before going to the hub the first time, jumps you forward to after the hub intro sequence.

-Patched missing s4br dialogue (after the intro, before the Ban Hammer cutscene)
-Fixed quick restart messing with the race countdown
-Fixed "Cinematic mode" Achievement not triggering in Main Menu
-Fixed begin able to liquid boost out of the pause menu in boss fights
-Fixed the upgrade menu allowing you to level stats more than possible
-Fixed the unpause button being stuck at the start of boss fights
-Fixed returning from the customize menu causing the pause menu to be unresponsive for a short while
-App name now says "Kitten Burst" and not "Kitten Burst Demo"
-Patched a possible sequence break when you first visit the hub
-Typos

----------------------------
